title: PeptiLine: An Interactive Platform for Customizable Functional Peptidomic Visualization and Analysis
description: Django web application that turns peptidomic mass-spectrometry output into annotated, statistically compared, sequence-mapped visualizations. Three linked modules: data transformation, data analysis, and heatmap visualization. This record archives the application version accompanying Kuhfeld, Nielsen and Dallas, Journal of Proteome Research, 2026.
